decision: No production gameplay correction accepted: development and controlled evidence isolate severe access/selection discrepancies but do not establish a safe narrow mechanical/coefficient repair. Freeze unchanged merged PR174 for one sealed validation evaluation; no tuning after opening it.

hypotheses.evidence: Every research released PassDiagnostic matches official attempts. Self-reclaim is not a completed teammate pass.
No owner/incoming selected shot lacks a release in six completed development games; restart release is a separate lifecycle.
208 prescribed shots give real saves, misses, blocks and a post; complete canonical physical outcomes retained.
Development: 1608 episodes,326 final-third control,39 box control,11 credible episodes,7 shots. Candidate presence is not a guarantee of useful football.
Real backward/lateral releases and reciprocal exchanges; retained/max progression measured. No unsupported universal progressive bonus accepted.
Generated marginal shots frequently rank below carry/pass; 35 credible decision observations but very few releases. Internal estimates are uncalibrated.
Frozen real state can score after carry as well as immediate shot; another prescribed shot produces no goal. More attempts alone fails the acceptance gate.
Available underlap can lose independent ranking; covered routes legitimately fail. No evidence for weakening defence.
Five press variants produce losses and no shots; timed run changes local metres, not robust escape.
10 controlled history/context variants initially choose carry; actual subsequent outcomes retained separately.
Persistent law restrictions can precede many unrelated possessions. Final attribution requires exact continuous episode lineage; raw hints retained.
